newsitem.title: USA: Flowers' Varnedoe to retire as president/COO.
newsitem.headline: Flowers' Varnedoe to retire as president/COO.

text.p: Flowers Industries Inc Tuesday said its president and chief operating officer, Heeth Varnedoe III, will retire on June 28, 1997, after 37 years of service to the company.

Varnedoe's duties will be assumed by George Deese, president and chief operating officer of Flowers Bakeries Inc and Gary Harrison, president and chief operating officer of Mrs. Smith's Bakeries Inc. Flowers Bakeries and Mrs. Smith's Bakeries are business units of Flowers Industries.
The company said Varnedoe will remain on Flowers Industries' board of directors, serve as a consultant to the company, and will pursue his work in lay ministry.
Flowers Industries produces and markets a variety of fresh and frozen baked foods to retail and foodservice customers nationally.
